Parliament Passes Anti-Paper Leak Bill Amidst Debate

India's Parliament has passed the Anti-Paper Leak Bill, with both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha approving the legislation. The bill aims to prevent malpractices and irregularities in public examinations. The passage followed heated debates between the government and opposition parties, with some opposition members staging a walkout. Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that "paper leak mafias will not be spared."
